o.text: Ultimately from Arabic أَدَبِيَّات pl (ʔadabiyyāt). By surface analysis, ədəb + -iyyat
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قنجارو (qancaru, “where”), from Proto-Turkic *kanča (“when”), derived from Proto-Turkic *ka-. Related to Uzbek qancha, Kyrgyz канча (kanca).
Borrowed from Russian иде́я (idéja), ultimately from Ancient Greek ἰδέᾱ (idéā).
